sentences.text: Ralph Nathaniel Twisleton-Wykeham-Fiennes -LRB- -LSB- ˈreɪf_ˈfaɪnz -RSB- born 22 December 1962 -RRB- is an English actor , director and producer .
A noted Shakespeare interpreter , he first achieved success onstage at the Royal National Theatre .	Shakespeare	William Shakespeare	Royal National Theatre	Royal National Theatre
